features: SCREEN SIZE: This portable monitor, designed for desktops, features a 39.6cm (15.6-inch) anti-glare screen, making it perfect for boosting productivity.
ASPECT RATIO: This outstanding desktop monitor features a native 16:9 aspect ratio and consumes just 13W (Max.) of power.
COLOR COMPATIBILITY: Capable of displaying 16.7M colors for a vivid and detailed view, this wall-mountable monitor delivers an immersive and productive experience.
INPUT CONNECTIONS: With dual input options, including type-C port, type-C DP port, and mini-HDMI, this monitor offers broad compatibility with a wide range of devices.
RESOLUTION: Enhance your viewing experience with a Full HD (1920x1080) resolution display.
DISPLAY & BRIGHTNESS: The monitor's brightness can be adjusted to display up to 250 nits (Max.).
METAL STAND: The durable metal stand adds stability and elegance to the monitor, complemented by a 60° adjustable design for versatile viewing and an ultra-slim panel for a modern appeal.
